name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload.

interface.longDescription: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload.

skillInstructions: 加载本插件技能时：生成草稿前先跑 headless_draft.py doctor 确认 fork 检出与剪映 11.4.x 环境；已有草稿永不覆盖，发布需剪映完全关闭。
